findings.message: Gradient fill. Use a flat colour or a real image (a neutral scrim over a photo is the one exception).
Gradient fill. Use a flat colour or a real image (a neutral scrim over a photo is the one exception).
Shadow. Elements at rest carry none; only real overlays (menu, dialog, sticky bar) may.
Em-dash habit. Use a full stop or a comma; keep at most one or two on a page.
